Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value "true", only when the answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

400.description: Malformed JSON body (malformed-json), window_start/window_end not RFC 3339 (malformed-window-start / malformed-window-end), a window whose end is not after its start (invalid-capacity-window), a NUL character in the body (malformed-request-body), or the Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or malformed (idempotency-key-invalid).

409.description: Constraint rate unit does not match the aggregate's established native unit (unit-mismatch), or the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request (idempotency-key-reused).

422.description: Negative quantity (negative-quantity) or a non-positive period_seconds (non-positive-period).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
